_meta.label: MedSafe AI demonstration knowledge base
_meta.note: Compact, hand-curated educational summaries of widely documented pharmacology. This is NOT DrugBank or any licensed dataset and is not exhaustive. Always verify against current official labelling.

medicines.name: Warfarin
medicines.use: Used to reduce the risk of harmful blood clots, for example in atrial fibrillation or after a clot in a vein or artery.
medicines.admin: Dose is individualised and adjusted using blood tests (INR). It is generally taken at a consistent time each day. Follow your prescriber's schedule exactly.
warnings: Increases bleeding risk; report unusual bruising, black stools or prolonged bleeding.
Many medicines, supplements and diet changes can alter its effect.
Regular INR monitoring is part of safe use.

medicines.name: Aspirin
medicines.use: Low doses are used to reduce platelet clumping in people at risk of heart attack or stroke; higher doses relieve pain, fever and inflammation.
medicines.admin: Enteric-coated and plain forms exist. Follow the label or prescription for your specific indication.
warnings: Can irritate the stomach and increase bleeding risk.
Not for children and teenagers with viral illness (Reye syndrome risk).
Avoid if previously allergic to aspirin or other NSAIDs unless advised by a clinician.

medicines.name: Omeprazole
medicines.use: Reduces stomach acid; used for reflux, ulcers and to protect the stomach during some long-term treatments.
medicines.admin: Delayed-release capsules or tablets are usually swallowed whole. Timing relative to meals is given on your label or prescription.
warnings: Long-term use may affect magnesium, vitamin B12 and bone health.
Can reduce activation of some medicines (e.g. clopidogrel) via CYP2C19.
Persistent stomach symptoms should be assessed by a clinician.

medicines.name: Ibuprofen
medicines.use: Relieves pain, fever and inflammation.
medicines.admin: Usually taken with food or milk to reduce stomach upset; use the lowest effective dose as directed on the label.
warnings: Can cause stomach ulcers and bleeding.
May raise blood pressure and affect kidney function.
May interfere with the antiplatelet effect of low-dose aspirin.

medicines.name: Paracetamol (Acetaminophen)
medicines.use: Relieves mild to moderate pain and reduces fever.
medicines.admin: Many combination products contain paracetamol; always check totals on all labels. Follow the label for maximum daily limits.
warnings: Overdose can cause serious liver damage.
Regular high intake can raise INR in people taking warfarin.
Check combination cold/flu products for hidden paracetamol.

medicines.name: Metformin
medicines.use: Helps control blood glucose in type 2 diabetes.
medicines.admin: Commonly taken with meals to reduce digestive upset; extended-release forms differ. Follow your prescription.
warnings: Rare but serious lactic acidosis, mainly with kidney impairment.
Kidney function is monitored during treatment.
Tell clinicians before contrast imaging or surgery.

medicines.name: Amlodipine
medicines.use: Lowers blood pressure and helps prevent angina.
medicines.admin: Usually taken once daily; follow your prescription.
warnings: May cause ankle swelling, flushing or dizziness.
Effects can be increased by strong CYP3A4 inhibitors.

medicines.name: Atorvastatin
medicines.use: Lowers cholesterol and reduces cardiovascular risk.
medicines.admin: Follow the prescription; timing is specified by your prescriber.
warnings: Report unexplained muscle pain or weakness.
Liver tests may be monitored.
Levels can rise with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors.

medicines.name: Simvastatin
medicines.use: Lowers cholesterol and reduces cardiovascular risk.
medicines.admin: Follow the prescription; timing is specified by your prescriber.
warnings: Higher risk of muscle injury with certain interacting medicines.
Avoid grapefruit juice in large amounts unless advised.

medicines.name: Clopidogrel
medicines.use: Reduces the risk of clots after heart attack, stent placement or stroke.
medicines.admin: Follow the prescription; do not stop without medical advice.
warnings: Increases bleeding risk.
Needs CYP2C19 to be activated; some medicines reduce this.
Tell clinicians before surgery or dental procedures.

medicines.name: Lisinopril
medicines.use: Treats high blood pressure and heart failure and protects the kidneys in some conditions.
medicines.admin: Follow your prescription.
warnings: Can raise potassium.
Dry cough is common; swelling of face or lips needs urgent care.
Avoid in pregnancy.

medicines.name: Losartan
medicines.use: Treats high blood pressure and protects the kidneys in some conditions.
medicines.admin: Follow your prescription.
warnings: Can raise potassium.
Avoid in pregnancy.

medicines.name: Digoxin
medicines.use: Used for certain heart rhythm problems and heart failure.
medicines.admin: Narrow therapeutic range; follow your prescription and monitoring schedule.
warnings: Toxicity can cause nausea, vision changes and dangerous rhythm problems.
Blood levels are raised by several medicines (e.g. amiodarone).
Low potassium increases toxicity risk.

medicines.name: Amiodarone
medicines.use: Treats serious heart rhythm disorders.
medicines.admin: Specialist-initiated; follow your prescription and monitoring.
warnings: Affects thyroid, lung, liver and eyes with long-term use.
Inhibits several enzymes and transporters, so it interacts with many medicines.
Can prolong the QT interval.

medicines.name: Fluoxetine
medicines.use: Treats depression, anxiety-related conditions and some other disorders.
medicines.admin: Follow your prescription; do not stop suddenly without advice.
warnings: Can increase bleeding tendency, especially with NSAIDs or anticoagulants.
Inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP2C9.
Report agitation, fever, tremor or confusion urgently when combined with other serotonergic medicines.

medicines.name: Sertraline
medicines.use: Treats depression, anxiety-related conditions and some other disorders.
medicines.admin: Follow your prescription; do not stop suddenly without advice.
warnings: Can increase bleeding tendency, especially with NSAIDs or anticoagulants.
Report agitation, fever, tremor or confusion urgently when combined with other serotonergic medicines.

medicines.name: Tramadol
medicines.use: Treats moderate to severe pain.
medicines.admin: Follow the prescription strictly; it can be habit-forming.
warnings: Can cause drowsiness and breathing problems.
Raises seizure risk and has serotonergic activity.
Activated via CYP2D6; interacting medicines change its effect.

medicines.name: Clarithromycin
medicines.use: Treats certain bacterial infections.
medicines.admin: Take the full course as prescribed.
warnings: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitor, so interacts with many medicines.
Can prolong the QT interval.

medicines.name: Ciprofloxacin
medicines.use: Treats certain bacterial infections.
medicines.admin: Take the full course as prescribed; separate from dairy/mineral supplements as the label advises.
warnings: Tendon problems, nerve effects and QT prolongation are possible.
Inhibits CYP1A2; may increase warfarin effect in some people.

medicines.name: Ketoconazole
medicines.use: Treats certain fungal infections.
medicines.admin: Follow your prescription; liver monitoring may be needed.
warnings: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitor.
Can cause liver injury.

medicines.name: Methotrexate
medicines.use: Used for certain cancers and autoimmune conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis.
medicines.admin: Dosing schedules differ greatly (some are weekly); follow the prescription exactly.
warnings: Can suppress bone marrow and affect liver and kidneys.
Reduced kidney clearance (e.g. with NSAIDs) can raise levels.
Regular blood tests are required.

medicines.name: Naproxen
medicines.use: Relieves pain and inflammation.
medicines.admin: Usually taken with food; use the lowest effective dose per the label.
warnings: Can cause stomach ulcers and bleeding.
May raise blood pressure and affect kidney function.

medicines.name: Diclofenac
medicines.use: Relieves pain and inflammation.
medicines.admin: Follow label or prescription; topical and oral forms differ.
warnings: Can cause stomach ulcers and bleeding.
Cardiovascular and kidney risks with long-term use.

medicines.name: Spironolactone
medicines.use: Treats heart failure, high blood pressure and fluid retention.
medicines.admin: Follow your prescription; blood potassium is monitored.
warnings: Can cause high potassium, especially with ACE inhibitors or ARBs.
Kidney function monitoring is important.

medicines.name: Furosemide
medicines.use: Removes excess fluid in heart failure, kidney or liver disease and can lower blood pressure.
medicines.admin: Follow your prescription; timing is usually set to avoid night-time urination.
warnings: Can lower potassium and sodium and cause dehydration.
Low potassium increases digoxin toxicity risk.

medicines.name: Levothyroxine
medicines.use: Replaces thyroid hormone in hypothyroidism.
medicines.admin: Absorption is affected by food and some supplements; follow your label's timing instructions.
warnings: Dose is adjusted using blood tests.
Calcium, iron and some acid-reducing medicines can reduce absorption.

medicines.name: Sildenafil
medicines.use: Treats erectile dysfunction and, at other strengths, pulmonary arterial hypertension.
medicines.admin: Follow your prescription.
warnings: Must not be combined with nitrates; the combination can cause severe low blood pressure.
Seek urgent care for chest pain or prolonged erection.

medicines.name: Nitroglycerin
medicines.use: Relieves or prevents angina (chest pain from reduced heart blood flow).
medicines.admin: Forms (spray, sublingual, patch) are used differently; follow the label and your clinician's instructions.
warnings: Can cause headache and low blood pressure.
Never combine with PDE5 inhibitors such as sildenafil.
Chest pain that does not settle needs urgent medical care.
